جَهْمٌ A coarse, or rough, and contracted, and ugly, face; as also ↓ جَهِمٌ ; (K;) or, as in some of the lexicons, ↓ جَهِيمٌ . (TA.) And جَهْمُ الوَجْهِ Frowning, or contracted, in face; or grinning in face, with a frowning, or contraction, or a stern, an austere, or a morose, look: (S, Mgh:) or coarse, or rough, in face: (JK, TA:) applied to a man: (JK, S, Mgh, TA:) and to a lion. (JK, TA.) And [hence,] الجَهْمُ The lion. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also جَهُومٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
